Meth Made Me Better Looking
Began exercising and tanning and working harder. Got promotion and a raise. Met beautiful women who had never tried drugs and had no idea I did them. Then I quit after a year and have not thought about it since. Am now in great shape have a great job and a few beautiful women. It is bad if improperly used and abused. Regulation is what I had to practice. Exercise keeps me from becoming dependent on anything. Willpower and determination and I could stop and live sober like I am now.
